description: I am D. Jamal Asraf, Founder of Space Hover & CGT, pursuing Aeronautical Engineering. I build aerospace simulations and full-stack web applications. Join our team to build an intuitive Lunar Landing Site Navigator for NASA Space Apps. We combine first-principles engineering with rapid prototyping. Seeking members skilled in orbital mechanics, GIS/LOLA topography, 3D visualization, and web development. Inshallah, let's build a mission-critical tool
